look: Cinder Elemental, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Cinder Motes family: pillar of black fire with arms, around a red orb. Family anatomy: living sparks and fire elementals of black flame around a red orb. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are ember-red cinder crystal. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, clear embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
